UPDATE users
            SET 
                username = $1,
                email = NULL,
                password = $2,
                nickname = '已注销用户',
                avatar_url = NULL,
                phone = $3,
                address = NULL,
                head_image = NULL,
                head_image_thumb = NULL,
                user_stat = 3,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $4
